colors.name: Forest Canopy
colors.role: Primary page background, nav strip, footer canvas - the dominant surface that defines the entire brand atmosphere

colors.name: Vault Floor
colors.role: Card surfaces, recessed panels, elevated content blocks within the forest canvas

colors.name: Canopy Mid
colors.role: Elevated card variant, highlighted surface tier above the base canvas

colors.name: Lime Phosphor
colors.role: Primary action buttons, active state indicators, illustrative highlight panels, brand-accent moments - the sole chromatic signal in the system

colors.name: Moss Border
colors.role: Hairline dividers, list separators, subtle table borders - barely-there green-on-green rules

colors.name: Fern
colors.role: Secondary accent strokes, table emphasis borders, mid-saturation green used sparingly for variety within lime contexts

colors.name: White
colors.role: Body text, heading text, icon strokes, ghost button borders, link colors, input fields - the only neutral light tone in the palette

fonts.name: Denim Ink
fonts.role: All interface text - from tiny labels to massive display headlines. The custom geometric face is the voice of the brand; weight 400 covers body and body-large, 600 for subheadings and emphasized inline, 700 reserved for the largest display moments. Extreme size jumps (40 64 86 94) create a poster-like hierarchy where the largest text dwarfs everything else on the page.

fonts.name: Courier New
fonts.role: Tiny monospaced labels (8px) for micro-annotations, likely near icons or status indicators. Ultra-tight tracking (-0.14em) at this size reads as a decorative tech-glitch element rather than readable text.

components.name: CTA Card / Feature Card with Image
components.role: Feature cards combining text and visual

do: Use #bdff00 lime as the ONLY filled action color in the system; never substitute another hue for primary CTAs.
Set headlines at 64-94px with Denim Ink weight 600-700 and -0.045em tracking - the extreme size and tight tracking is the brand's visual signature.
Maintain the monochromatic green discipline: layer surfaces using #1b2d00 #203400 #335400, never introduce gray neutrals.
Use 32px radius for all cards and 16px radius for all buttons; pill shapes (9999px) are reserved for nav items and tag chips.
Place an 8px lime dot before every section eyebrow label - it is the brand's 'live signal' indicator.
Keep body text in Denim Ink weight 400 at 16-20px, #ffffff, with line-height 1.5 and -0.02em tracking.
Allow sections to breathe with 80px vertical gaps and full-width dark bands - density comes from content, not from tight spacing.
doNot: Never use #bdff00 as a large background outside of one featured decorative panel per page - rationing lime is what makes it feel like a signal.
Do not introduce drop shadows for elevation; the system separates layers through color tier shifts, not shadow depth.
Do not use gray (#808080, #999, etc.) for any UI element - the palette is green-monochrome plus white and lime only.
Never set body text below 16px except for the 8px Courier New micro-labels - legibility is non-negotiable.
Do not mix multiple accent greens (#73a303, #586740) into the same component - one accent per surface keeps the hierarchy clean.
Do not add gradients - the design relies on flat color blocks for its terminal/phosphor aesthetic.
Do not use heavy font weights below 32px - Denim Ink at weight 700 in body sizes destroys readability; reserve 700 for display moments only.
